about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: A coordinated supply partner for electrical contracting and industrial panel supply.
about.body1: Eurasia Endüstriyel Enerji San. ve Tic. Ltd. Şti. is based in Tuzla, Istanbul, and operates in electrical contracting services, project-specific low-voltage panel production coordination and industrial electrical material supply.
about.body2: For electrical contractors, system integrators, OEM manufacturers and project companies, we coordinate sourcing, panel assembly, wiring, testing and export preparation starting from a single-line diagram, BOM, drawing or technical specification. Components can be selected according to the customer's preferred brand, model, technical standard and approved alternatives.
about.value1Desc: Panel dimensions, cable entry, IP level, internal separation, metering and communication are defined per project.
about.value2Desc: Components can be selected according to your preferred brand, model, technical standard and approved alternatives.
about.value3Desc: Inspection and documentation referenced to relevant standards such as IEC/EN 61439-1/-2, IEC 60529, IEC 60947, IEC 60204-1, IEC 61800.
about.imageAlt: Eurasia field engineer servicing a transformer and generator

services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: From electrical contracting to panel supply, coordinated from a single point.
services.s1Desc: Low-voltage installation works, panel assembly coordination, wiring and execution of site application processes.
services.s2Desc: MDB, SMDB, PCC, MCC, machine panels and more — project-specific production coordination against approved BOMs and drawings.
services.s3Desc: Material supply for breakers, contactors, relays, meters and panel components, according to your preferred brands and models.
services.s4Desc: Starting from single-line diagrams, load lists and control philosophy, deciding on the right panel configuration together.
services.s5Desc: Document review, assembly inspection, electrical checks and export-ready packaging/documentation.
services.s6Desc: Digital management of port, truck and container parking areas: vehicle and container tracking, yard planning and operational reporting.
